name: Territory War
author: Addicting Games
description: Territory War is a free strategy game of attrition. War... war changes basically all of the time. It used to be fought with sticks and stones, and then we discovered flint rock and made bows and arrows. At some point someone discovered gunpowder. The weapons got bigger, louder, faster, eventually, we split the atom and now robots do all the fighting for us, yay! So, yeah. War changes constantly. It's basically a never-ending flux. Sometimes we fight over religion or resources, or philosophy, but mostly its territory. And that is what this war is about: Territory. This is truly a territory war. You'll be in charge of an entire legion of stick troops throughout the ages. All of them with various types of shields, weapons, and whatever. Upgrade your units, your items, and your various battlements. Encroach upon your opponent's territory until there is nothing left for them to fight for! Conqueror be conquered! Dominate with extreme prejudice or bow down to the iron heel of those who would have you on your knees. Its a tale as old as time. Huh, maybe war doesn't change? Someone should write that down.
